<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="15" x2="318" y2="21" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2"/>

    <line x1="328" y1="11" x2="328" y2="21" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2"/>

    <rect x="359" y="13" width="15" height="8" rx="2" fill="#5DB329"/>

  <g>

    <text x="53" y="64" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">mint</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="328" y="47" width="42" height="26" rx="13" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
      <text x="349" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">Skip</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Illustration shadow and panel -->
  <rect x="25" y="91" width="340" height="300" rx="28" fill="#063336" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect x="25" y="88" width="340" height="300" rx="28" fill="#EAF8E3"/>
  
  <!-- Decorative leaves -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="135" rx="13" ry="29" fill="#ADD993" transform="rotate(-35 62 135)"/>

  <ellipse cx="328" cy="132" rx="12" ry="27" fill="#5DB075" transform="rotate(38 328 132)"/>

  <circle cx="84" cy="111" r="5" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  <circle cx="306" cy="175" r="6" fill="#D4FCBC"/>

  <ellipse cx="195" cy="332" rx="116" ry="25" fill="#B3E5C8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="318" rx="98" ry="25" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="312" rx="79" ry="19" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  <path d="M118 267 Q195 290 272 267 L258 313 Q195 338 132 313 Z" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="267" rx="78" ry="23" fill="#4B9460"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="263" rx="66" ry="17" fill="#66CC91"/>

  <circle cx="157" cy="258" r="12" fill="#FFAE1B"/>
  <circle cx="190" cy="254" r="13" fill="#E7574C"/>

  <ellipse cx="141" cy="278" rx="8" ry="13" fill="#5DB075" transform="rotate(-32 141 278)"/>

  <line x1="102" y1="235" x2="102" y2="305" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="3"/>

  <ellipse cx="285" cy="239" rx="8" ry="14" fill="#4B9460"/>
  <line x1="285" y1="251" x2="285" y2="306" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Copy -->
  <text x="195" y="446" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Good food, good mood.</text>
  <text x="195" y="478" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Discover delicious homemade meals</text>
  <text x="195" y="502" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">from kitchens and makers near you.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="533" width="101" height="30" rx="15" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="548" r="7" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="44,548 47,551 52,545" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="61" y="553" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#267347">Fresh meals</text>
    
    <rect x="144" y="533" width="103" height="30" rx="15" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="161" cy="548" r="7" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="157,548 160,551 165,545" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <rect x="259" y="533" width="100" height="30" rx="15" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="276" cy="548" r="7" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="272,548 275,551 280,545" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="289" y="553" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#267347">Easy delivery</text>

    <circle cx="174" cy="591" r="5" fill="#5DB329"/>

    <line x1="328" y1="644" x2="337" y2="644" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  </g>

  <rect x="0" y="705" width="390" height="1" fill="#EEEEEE"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="34,735 44,727 54,735" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="37" y="734" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="44" y="767" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Home</text>

    <circle cx="119" cy="735" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="125" y1="741" x2="131" y2="747" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>

    <rect x="184" y="727" width="20" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="189" y1="733" x2="199" y2="733" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="189" y1="738" x2="199" y2="738" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="194" y="767" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Orders</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="281" cy="731" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="281" cy="744" rx="10" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="281" y="767" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Profile</text>
    <!-- More -->
    <circle cx="352" cy="732" r="2" fill="#97A2B0"/>
    <circle cx="352" cy="738" r="2" fill="#97A2B0"/>
    <circle cx="352" cy="744" r="2" fill="#97A2B0"/>
    <text x="352" y="767" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">More</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="140" y="816" width="110" height="5" rx="3" fill="#0A2533"/>
</svg>
